get.description: Gives the ability to filter and search objects of various types: articles, datasets, institutions, resources, showcases.

parameters.name: X-API-VERSION
parameters.description: Sets API version.

parameters.name: Accept-Language

schema.description: Sets language code. Supported languages are english (en) and polish (pl)

parameters.description: Sets language code. Supported languages are english (en) and polish (pl)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Default value is 1.

parameters.name: per_page

schema.description: Page size. Default value is 25, max allowed page size is 100.

parameters.description: Page size. Default value is 25, max allowed page size is 100.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Allows searching for the provided value in multiple fields.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort instances by following fields in ascending or descending direction.

FieldExamples
title/search/?sort=title
/search/?sort=-title
date/search/?sort=date
/search/?sort=-date
views_count/search/?sort=views_count
/search/?sort=-views_count

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Filter instances by ID.

This field provides following filters:

FilterDescriptionExamples
termfilters instances in which ID matches to the provided value.
Note, that this is default filter for this field.		/search/?id=1
/search/?id[term]=2
termsfilters instances in which ID matches to any of the provided values./search/?id[terms]=1,3
/search/?id[terms]=1&id[terms]=3
gtfilters instances in which ID is is greater than the provided value./search/?id[gt]=1
gtefilters instances in which ID is greater than or equal to the provided value./search/?id[gte]=2
ltfilters instances in which ID is lower than the provided value./search/?id[lt]=3
ltefilters instances that have ID that is lower than or equal to the provided value./search/?id[lte]=4

/search/?model[terms]=article&model[terms]=showcase
